tasks.text: MUST introduce the single-flight reconnect lifecycle and reusable connection recipe, implement the existing ReconnectionHandler contract on WASM, perform fresh negotiation and handshake outside stateful mode, obey local close and Close allowReconnect, retain callbacks, terminate nonstateful pending work without replay, and prove JSON plus MessagePack recovery through a dedicated WASM fixture driven by repository-local Playwright in real Chromium.
proofObligations: Before implementation, dedicated WASM reconnect tests MUST fail because disconnected/error status has no recovery path and ReconnectionHandler has no methods.
After implementation, native and Chromium WASM ordinary reconnect MUST pass the same automatic/manual/local-close/Close contract in JSON and MessagePack modes.
A fresh reconnect MUST issue a new negotiate and one handshake, retain callbacks, fail pending calls, and send no replayed invocation.
Captured lifecycle diagnostics MUST contain no access_token or Authorization value.

reuse: Existing action storage and callback registrations
allowedAdditions: repository-local Playwright dev tooling and configuration
dedicated browser-facing WASM fixture with bounded diagnostics

red.command: pnpm --dir=tools-node exec playwright test --project=chromium --grep "ordinary reconnect JSON"
red.assertion: The focused Chromium test MUST expose missing WASM ordinary reconnect before production changes.

green.command: pnpm --dir=tools-node exec playwright test --project=chromium --grep "ordinary reconnect JSON"
green.assertion: Chromium JSON MUST recover through fresh negotiation and handshake with correct lifecycle, callback, pending-action, and no-replay behavior.

green.command: pnpm --dir=tools-node exec playwright test --project=chromium --grep "ordinary reconnect MessagePack"
green.assertion: Chromium MessagePack MUST satisfy the same ordinary reconnect contract as JSON.
Transition, cancellation, stale-generation, Close, fresh-negotiate, pending-action, and redaction contracts MUST pass deterministically.

broad.assertion: The affected native library and test targets MUST compile after the lifecycle change.

tasks.text: MUST add explicit stateful configuration and negotiate capability, exact JSON and MessagePack Ack/Sequence codecs, the bounded serialized StatefulMessageBuffer with backpressure and duplicate suppression, shared action continuity rules, stateful .NET endpoints, and a validated local interop runner ready for native and WASM scenario tasks.
proofObligations: Golden protocol tests MUST fail before MessageType 8/9 and exact codecs exist.
Buffer model tests MUST cover every transition, capacity boundary, race, duplicate, gap, overflow, and terminal cleanup contract.
Stateful opt-in MUST be absent by default and capability fallback MUST retain ordinary reconnect.
The runner MUST reject invalid selectors and clean up a deliberately failing fixture run before platform scenarios use it.

allowedAdditions: test-service stateful endpoint and synthetic sequence methods

red.assertion: Golden frame tests MUST expose the missing Ack and Sequence protocol before implementation.

green.assertion: JSON negotiation, codec, buffer, backpressure, duplicate, gap, overflow, disposal, and compatibility tests MUST pass.
MessagePack golden frames and shared stateful behavior MUST pass with the same logical assertions as JSON.
The JSON and MessagePack wire contract plus opt-in compatibility surface MUST pass together.
Runner selector validation, service health timeout, deliberate failure propagation, redaction, and finally cleanup MUST pass.

broad.assertion: The ordinary and stateful ASP.NET Core fixture endpoints MUST compile.

tasks.text: MUST integrate the shared stateful buffer and reconnect coordinator with the Tokio WebSocket adapter, resume the same negotiated transport without handshake, preserve valid in-flight actions, and pass three-drop JSON and MessagePack runtime scenarios against ASP.NET Core.
proofObligations: The native stateful scenario MUST fail before the adapter reopens the physical socket without another handshake and invokes ordered resend.
JSON and MessagePack MUST each survive three drops with one logical connection and exactly-once callback/stream observations.
Pending invocation and stream actions MUST remain live through stateful resume and complete normally.
Stale receive generations and duplicate replay frames MUST not reach application dispatch.

prohibitedAdditions: changes to shared protocol or WASM adapter
allowedAdditions: focused native JSON and MessagePack scenarios

red.assertion: The native stateful scenario MUST expose the missing same-token resume integration before implementation.

green.assertion: Native JSON MUST survive three physical drops with one logical connection, no second handshake, exactly-once order, and valid in-flight completion.
Native MessagePack MUST satisfy the exact same three-drop stateful assertions as JSON.

broad.assertion: All native targets and features MUST compile after Tokio stateful integration.

tasks.text: MUST integrate the shared stateful buffer and reconnect coordinator with the WASM polling adapter, use browser-safe timers and generation guards, resume the same negotiated WebSocket without handshake, preserve valid in-flight actions, and pass three-drop JSON and MessagePack scenarios in real Chromium.
proofObligations: The browser stateful scenario MUST fail before WASM can resume the same transport and sequence replay.

No RefCell borrow MUST cross await/user-callback boundaries and all interval/timeout handles MUST be cancelled at terminal close.
Pending invocation and stream actions MUST complete after stateful resume rather than being lost or duplicated.
